value.description: Self-identified native speakers of English located in the United States, recruited through Prolific (paper §2.3, §3.3, §5.2). Eligibility and consent per the information sheet at http://factslab.io/information_sheet_021523.pdf. Fullscreen mode was required throughout. Average payment rate $14.31/hour (§2.3).
